breakdown.rationale: Physical accessibility features are itemized (ramps, lifts, bars and handles, dedicated washrooms for differently abled employees), but no digital accessibility measures are disclosed at all.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose digital accessibility measures such as website/app accessibility or assistive technology support.

breakdown.rationale: The Company confirms an equal opportunity policy under the RPwD Act, 2016 and provides a public web link to its Diversity, Equal Opportunity and Freedom of Association policy, but no concrete accommodation request/approval process is described.
breakdown.recommendation: Describe a concrete process for employees to request and receive workplace accommodations.

breakdown.rationale: Specific but very small headcounts are disclosed (2 differently abled permanent employees, 1 differently abled permanent worker, all male), with no percentage of total workforce or trend context.
breakdown.recommendation: Report PwD headcount as a percentage of total workforce and track it over time.

breakdown.rationale: No disability-specific recruitment targets, outreach programs, or hiring attainment figures are disclosed anywhere in the filing.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose any disability-specific hiring targets or outreach programs and report attainment against them.

breakdown.rationale: General parental-leave return/retention rates are disclosed but not broken out for PwD employees specifically.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose attrition and retention data specifically for PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: No data on PwD representation in senior or management roles is disclosed anywhere in the filing.
breakdown.recommendation: Report PwD representation broken out by seniority/management level.

breakdown.rationale: No disability-specific training or sensitization program is described; only general EHS and human rights training are mentioned.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose any disability sensitization or accessibility training programs offered to employees.

breakdown.rationale: No ongoing PwD-specific culture practices (ERG, flexible work, accommodation response-time commitments) are disclosed.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose ongoing culture practices supporting PwD employees, such as a dedicated employee resource group.

breakdown.rationale: General grievance committees are described for workers and employees, but none are disability-specific and no PwD satisfaction data is given.
breakdown.recommendation: Disclose satisfaction or grievance-resolution data specific to PwD employees.

breakdown.rationale: The filing does not state RPwD Act quota attainment as a percentage or claim any accessibility conformance standard; only a general policy-alignment statement is made.
breakdown.recommendation: State the RPwD Act statutory quota attainment percentage or any accessibility conformance standard achieved.
